content.value_statement: AI projects lose quality when context is stale, noisy, or poorly routed. This skill helps design retrieval, memory, and agent context systems.
actual_capabilities: Guides dynamic context assembly and relevance filtering.
Designs vector database and embedding strategies.
Plans knowledge graph and semantic retrieval systems.
Defines memory architecture for long-running AI interactions.
Coordinates context handoff across multi-agent workflows.
Advises on latency, freshness, cost, and quality metrics.
limitations: Provides architecture guidance, not a runnable implementation.
Requires project details, data sources, and constraints.
Does not include tests, scripts, or packaged integrations.
Cannot validate live vector databases without tool access.

use_cases.title: Design RAG Context Architecture
use_cases.description: AI engineers can plan retrieval, chunking, embeddings, and context assembly for enterprise search systems.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Multi-Agent Workflows
use_cases.description: Automation teams can define context handoffs, state ownership, and routing between specialized agents.

use_cases.title: Plan Enterprise Memory Governance
use_cases.description: Platform leaders can outline privacy, retention, audit, and scaling practices for shared AI memory.

prompt_templates.title: Map Context Needs
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define context requirements for [project]. Include users, data sources, constraints, freshness needs, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design RAG Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG context architecture for [use case]. Cover chunking, embeddings, retrieval, ranking, caching, and evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Agent Handoffs
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a multi-agent context handoff plan for [workflow]. Define state, routing rules, memory updates, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Context System
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this context architecture: [summary]. Identify risks, missing governance, performance bottlenecks, and improvements for production operation.

output_examples.input: Design context management for customer support agents.
output: A context map covering customer, ticket, policy, and conversation memory.
A retrieval plan with freshness rules, ranking criteria, and privacy controls.
A handoff model for escalation between triage, billing, and technical agents.

output_examples.input: Optimize RAG for a large documentation portal.
output: A retrieval tuning checklist for chunk size, hybrid search, reranking, and caching.
Evaluation metrics for relevance, latency, cost, and answer grounding.
A rollout plan with monitoring and feedback loops.

output_examples.input: Create memory rules for long-running AI conversations.
output: A memory taxonomy for working, episodic, and semantic information.
Retention and deletion policies aligned with user consent.
Quality checks for stale, conflicting, or sensitive context.

best_practices: Start with context goals, users, data sensitivity, and measurable success criteria.
Separate working memory, long-term memory, and retrieval indexes.
Track relevance, latency, cost, freshness, and privacy outcomes after deployment.
anti_patterns: Storing every interaction without retention rules or user consent.
Building retrieval pipelines before defining evaluation criteria.
Sharing context across agents without ownership, scope, or security boundaries.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps design AI context systems for retrieval, memory, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent workflows.

faq.question: Does it install software?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and does not install packages or run commands.

faq.question: Can it choose a vector database?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare options and map them to scale, latency, cost, and governance needs.

faq.question: Is it useful for enterprise AI?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers governance, context isolation, audit trails, and system integration planning.

faq.question: Can it improve existing RAG systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review retrieval design, chunking, ranking, caching, and evaluation practices.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive data directly?
faq.answer: No. Users should provide requirements and policies, not confidential records or secrets.
